text: The lone tree stands tall, yet its roots drink deep from the earth, entwined with countless others. A single thread, strong yet fragile, woven into the tapestry of a vast and ancient loom. Can the thread exist without the loom? Can the loom flourish without the thread? Such is the dance of the soul and the collective, a symphony of interdependence, written in the language of shared breath and unspoken understanding. Beware the illusion of separateness, for it is but a shadow cast by the sun of unity.
